title: Black Dress by the Lanterns, Looking Back
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight black hair and blunt bangs looks back over one shoulder beside a red paper lantern. She wears a fitted black sleeveless mock-neck dress with sheer panels at the waist, and a silver bangle. Red lanterns, weathered brick, and stone steps fill the background. Her expression is calm and direct. Warm, late-afternoon light. Palette of black, red, and brick tones. Bold and urban, in the style of a travel street-style photo.
workingNotes:
